Tara (Billing): FYI Sentinel Security (vend-SN-51) reached out: they were paid twice for Q4 partner rebate. Payment 552300 was issued 12/18 and again 12/19. Net overpayment is $9,750. Attached: payment run logs and bank trace. Can we confirm and authorise refund to vendor?

billing-bot: Reconciliation complete: payments=552300,552371 duplicate_detected. Suggested actions: (1) create vendor credit and offset future payable; (2) issue ACH refund for $9,750. Note: bank trace suggests second payment cleared; refund may require vendor bank details confirmation.

Eli (Vendor Ops): I pulled vendor file. We have bank details but last verified 2023-11-02. Need vendor confirmation before ACH refund. Ops prefers to offset future payable when possible to minimize bank fees.

Victor (Vendor): Victor (Vendor): We confirm receipt of duplicate payment. Prefer ACH refund to our primary account; will send signed refund request PDF now.

Monica (Finance Lead): Two approvals needed: finance lead (that's me) and Legal signoff because duplicate payments >$5k set a precedent. I'm okay with refund by ACH. Please ensure vendor signs refund acknowledgement form and we retain it.

Sam (Legal): Confirming. Please obtain the vendor-signed refund request and attach to the vendor file. Also include a short memo on root cause (duplicate run in payout scheduler) and remediation steps. No contractual waivers required.

Tara (Billing): Created vendor credit record VC-2026-339 for $9,750 and pending ACH refund. Running `/vendor-refund refund 9,750 vend-SN-51 via=ACH note "Duplicate payout correction"`. Pending until vendor-signed PDF attached.

Eli (Vendor Ops): Received signed PDF from Victor. Uploaded to vendor portal and linked to VC-2026-339. Added note: "Vendor approves ACH refund to account ending -4321."

Tara (Billing): Executed ACH refund today. Bank trace ID BT-77421. Marking vendor credit posted and closing payable. Ledger entry JV-2026-210 created with memo "Sentinel duplicate payout refund".

Monica (Finance Lead): Thanks. Please add BO ticket BO-1533 to update payout scheduler to reject duplicate runs and add a post-run duplicate-payment smoke test. Assign to Vendor Ops, ETA next sprint.

Sam (Legal): Document added to records. Recommend we include a short clause in the vendor onboarding checklist to re-verify bank details before refunds.

Victor (Vendor): Victor (Vendor): Received refund, confirmed with bank. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Tara (Billing): Closing thread. Marking VC-2026-339 closed and payable reconciled. :white_check_mark:
